figs.name: fire-alarm-system-block-diagram
figs.alt: fire alarm system block diagram with detectors, control panel FACP and output devices
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing smoke, heat, flame and gas detectors and call points feeding the FACP, which drives hooters, beacons, sprinklers, gas suppression and the ECR.
figs.after_h2: Main Parts of a Fire Alarm System
figs.svg:

figs.name: fire-alarm-system-control-panel-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart of fire alarm control panel steps from detector signal to alarms and suppression
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog following the FACP sequence: check the signal, show the zone, sound alarms, start suppression and notify the emergency control room.
figs.after_h2: B) Control Panel – The Brain of the Fire Alarm System

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart of what the fire alarm control panel does after a detector signal</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">What the FACP Does When a Detector Trips</text>
<rect x="250" y="56" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="90.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Detector or call point signal</text>
<line x1="400" y1="112" x2="400" y2="132" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,134.0 560.0,186 400,238.0 240.0,186" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="181.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Real fire or</text>
<text x="400" y="203.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">false alarm?</text>
<line x1="240" y1="186" x2="184" y2="186" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="212" y="172" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">False</text>
<rect x="14" y="150" width="170" height="72" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="99.0" y="180.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Not a real fire,</text>
<text x="99.0" y="203.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">filtered out</text>
<line x1="400" y1="238" x2="400" y2="262" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="256" font-size="17" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Real</text>
<rect x="250" y="262" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="296.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Show zone or room on panel</text>
<line x1="400" y1="318" x2="400" y2="340" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="250" y="340" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ea580c" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="374.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sound hooters, flash beacons</text>
<line x1="400" y1="396" x2="400" y2="418" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="250" y="418" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ea580c" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="452.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Start suppression system</text>
<line x1="400" y1="474" x2="400" y2="496" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="250" y="496" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#7c2d12" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="530.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Notify ECR and fire service</text>
<rect x="590" y="300" width="190" height="160" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="685.0" y="339.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Suppression</text>
<text x="685.0" y="362.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">sprinklers</text>
<text x="685.0" y="385.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">deluge</text>
<text x="685.0" y="408.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">fire water pumps</text>
<text x="685.0" y="431.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">gas system</text>
<line x1="550" y1="446" x2="588" y2="420" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
</svg>

figs.name: fire-alarm-system-detector-selection-infographic
figs.alt: fire alarm system detector selection chart for smoke, flame, heat and gas detectors
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog matching each detector to the fires or places it suits, from ionization and photoelectric smoke detectors to UV, IR, heat and gas detectors.
figs.after_h2: A) Input Devices – How the System Detects Fire
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Which fire detector suits which fire or location</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Choosing the Right Fire Detector</text>
<rect x="20" y="62" width="760" height="48" fill="#7c2d12"/>
<text x="130" y="93" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Detector</text>
<text x="400" y="93" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Best for</text>
<text x="650" y="93" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Why</text>
<rect x="20" y="110" width="760" height="70" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#fed7aa"/>
<text x="130" y="152" font-size="18" fill="#ea580c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ionization smoke</text>
<text x="400" y="152" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Fast burning, flaming fires</text>
<text x="650" y="152" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">senses small smoke particles</text>
<rect x="20" y="180" width="760" height="70" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#fed7aa"/>
<text x="130" y="222" font-size="18" fill="#ea580c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Photoelectric smoke</text>
<text x="400" y="222" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Slow, smoldering fires</text>
<text x="650" y="222" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">fewer false alarms</text>
<rect x="20" y="250" width="760" height="70" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#fed7aa"/>
<text x="130" y="292" font-size="18" fill="#ea580c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">UV flame</text>
<text x="400" y="292" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Explosions, fast fires</text>
<text x="650" y="292" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">very fast response</text>
<rect x="20" y="320" width="760" height="70" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#fed7aa"/>
<text x="130" y="362" font-size="18" fill="#ea580c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IR flame</text>
<text x="400" y="362" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Dusty or smoky areas</text>
<text x="650" y="362" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">sees flame flicker</text>
<rect x="20" y="390" width="760" height="70" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#fed7aa"/>
<text x="130" y="432" font-size="18" fill="#ea580c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Heat detector</text>
<text x="400" y="432" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Kitchens, workshops, dust</text>
<text x="650" y="432" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">trips above preset limit</text>
<rect x="20" y="460" width="760" height="70" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#fed7aa"/>
<text x="130" y="502" font-size="18" fill="#ea580c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Gas detector</text>
<text x="400" y="502" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Flammable or toxic gas</text>
<text x="650" y="502" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">alerts before a fire starts</text>
<text x="400" y="556" font-size="17" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Combined UV and IR detectors are used to avoid false alarms</text>
</svg>
